title: Premium Response
description: Response payload from the pricing-policy service containing the computed premium breakdown.

request_id.description: Echoed idempotency key from the corresponding premium request.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy this premium applies to.

base_premium.description: Base premium amount before dynamic adjustments, derived from actuarial tables.

dynamic_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the base premium based on risk scores and behavioural incentives. Values < 1 indicate a discount; > 1 indicate a surcharge.

final_premium.description: Final premium amount (base_premium × dynamic_multiplier), after rounding and regulatory floors/caps.

adjustment_pct.description: Percentage adjustment. Negative = discount, positive = surcharge.

discount_breakdown.description: Itemised breakdown of adjustments that contribute to the dynamic multiplier (optional).

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which this quote expires and must be re-computed.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this premium was computed.

score_detail.description: Risk scoring details that informed the premium calculation.

usage_score.description: 0-100 usage score. Null when no trip data exists.

maintenance_score.description: 0-100 maintenance score. Null when health_status is 'insufficient_data' or 'not_evaluated'.

composite_score.description: 0-100 overall composite score. Null unless both component scores exist.

health_status.description: Whether a vehicle health score could be computed. 'scored' when events exist, 'insufficient_data' when no service events are on file, 'not_evaluated' when tracking consent is not established or vehicle is unregistered.

vehicle_health_score.description: Deterministic vehicle health score (0-100). Null when health_status is 'insufficient_data' or 'not_evaluated'.

health_confidence.description: 'unverified_self_reported' when every contributing service record is self_upload; 'verified' otherwise; null when not evaluated.

renewal_recommendation.description: Advisory renewal recommendation text. Never phrased as a denial.

has_open_recall.description: Open-recall flag from recall-status source. true/false when known; null when unknown/unavailable or not evaluated.

data_flags.description: Data-quality and tracking consent flags, e.g. 'conflicting_records_detected', 'recall_status_unavailable', 'usage_data_unavailable', 'consent_not_given_usage', 'consent_not_given_maintenance', 'vehicle_not_registered', 'consent_status_unavailable'.
